khse11.title: Aquarius is above the hot seat
khse11.caption:
Go quiet for a few days and hope people get it?
Tell them you're still there. It makes all the difference.

khse12.title: Pisces cried at question one
khse12.caption:
Cried at "how are you?" Same.
Big feelings usually mean a big heart. The right people will ask anyway.

khse13.title: Situationship round: Aries
khse13.caption:
Been "just talking" since spring?
Asking what this is isn't needy. It's brave.

khse14.title: Left on read round: Taurus
khse14.caption:
Read at 2:14 and it's now 9 p.m.?
A slow reply is just a slow reply. It's not a verdict on you.

khse15.title: 2 a.m. scroll round: Gemini
khse15.caption:
2 a.m., scrolling through everyone you used to know?
Put the phone down. Call a real friend tomorrow.

khse16.title: Advice giver round: Cancer
khse16.caption:
Gave the same advice to three friends this week?
Try taking it yourself. You'd tell them to.

khse17.title: Single at the dinner round: Leo
khse17.caption:
The only single one at the holiday table again?
You're not a missing seat. You're the whole guest.

khse18.title: Crush round: Virgo
khse18.caption:
Wrote a pros and cons list about your crush?
If the pros won, maybe the next step is just saying hello.

khse19.title: Breakup round: Libra
khse19.caption:
Stayed friends with everyone after the breakup, including their mum?
You're allowed to say it hurt. That isn't making it weird.
